items.title: Make the 5 receptionist retest calls
items.detail: Five owner retest calls on the rebuilt prompt before any gate can pass. Then review each call's flags on /receptionist.

items.title: Vercel Pro, TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS and alert email before the receptionist deploy
items.detail: Upgrade to Vercel Pro, set TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS and choose the alert email address in the MU-Receptionist project before its next production deploy.

items.title: Brooke reply draft is unsent
items.detail: A reply to Brooke is drafted and waiting. Read it, edit if needed and send it yourself; nothing sends automatically.

items.title: Website merges and deploys
items.detail: Marketing, dental, property and legal design branches need your reviewed release decision. No merge or deploy happens without it.

items.title: Choose the dental site opening
items.detail: The dental flagship's opening (the R14 faceless opening proof) is waiting on your choice before the dental release.

items.title: Decide: keep the legacy NAB routes closed
items.detail: Legacy NAB/Basiq access now fails closed without reviewed, code-owned authorisation. Confirm it stays closed or name what should reopen.

items.title: Choose the video narration voice

items.title: Check the 28 September call plan
items.detail: The dated call plan needs current readiness and contact checks before use. Prepared client drafts stay unsent until you approve them.
